Control.name: INSJY_Settings_TRAITSETTINGS
Control.OnInitialized: self.controlType = OPTIONS_DROPDOWN self.system = SETTING_TYPE_UI self.settingId = SETTINGS_INSJY_Settings_TRAITSETTINGS self.panel = "OPTIONS_PANEL_INSJUNKYARD2OPTIONS" self.text = "Autojunk quality limit" self.tooltipText = "Ornate items AT or BELOW this quality will be autojunked." self.valid = { "0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5" } self.valueStringPrefix = "SI_ITEMQUALITY" local dropdown = "INSJY_Settings_TRAITSETTINGS" local dropmenu = ZO_ComboBox_ObjectFromContainer(GetControl(dropdown, "Dropdown")) local setText = dropmenu.m_selectedItemText.SetText local selectedName ZO_PreHookHandler(dropmenu.m_selectedItemText, "OnTextChanged", function(self) if dropmenu.m_selectedItemData then selectedName = dropmenu.m_selectedItemData.name setText(self, selectedName) if insJY.protect==0 then -- get ID from name selected... wth. for k,v in ipairs(INSJY_Settings_TRAITSETTINGSDropdown["m_comboBox"]:GetItems()) do k = k-1 if v.name==selectedName then insJY.SVP.quality=k end end end end end) ZO_OptionsWindow_InitializeControl(self)
